# T-2: Add agent diagnostics

## Goal
Add provider/profile context and a stdout preview capped at 200 characters to relevant agent failure errors.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Errors with stdout include provider key and profile key.
- stdout preview is capped at 200 characters.
- Errors without stdout do not fabricate a preview.

## Implementation Notes
Keep formatting in src/lib/agent.js small and reusable; avoid logging secrets beyond already captured stdout and keep the preview cap fixed.

## Test Strategy
Spec-local tests assert error message content and preview length.
